title: Combo plus a genuinely separate paid side — included components still not swallowed or double counted
notes: Companion to conv_321: proves the fix direction for the BO-000004 class of bug does not overcorrect into merging every order into one line. A combo (which already includes chips) ordered alongside a genuinely separate paid side (Onion Rings) must produce TWO cart lines and a total that is the plain sum of both — the combo's bundled chips must not block, and must not be confused with, an explicitly separate paid item.

turns.message: I'll have the Smash Burger Combo with Coca-Cola, and also a side of Onion Rings
